title: Quick ops: hole patterns from numbers (point list, line, grid, bolt-hole circle) for Drill, Bore and Thread

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What is needed

Machinists frequently drill, tap, ream, bore, or thread-mill hole patterns without building a 3D model.

## Design

- Add parametric hole-pattern recipes in `camcraft-geometry` for:
  - Explicit XY point list.
  - Linear row (start XY, pitch, count, angle).
  - Rectangular grid (start XY, X/Y pitch, X/Y count, angle).
  - Full and partial bolt-hole circle (centre XY, circle diameter, hole count, start angle, angular pitch or arc span).
- Compute coordinates from standard trigonometry (Smid, *CNC Programming Handbook*, bolt-hole circle coordinates) and refuse degenerate or non-finite inputs by name.
- Populate `OpParams::Drill`, `OpParams::Bore`, and `OpParams::Thread` (`holes: Vec<Hole>` in `crates/motion/src/drilling/hole.rs`) from the pattern on a stock-only setup or a `Sketch` of circles, without requiring a 3D solid model.
- Keep existing drilling canned-cycle posting (`G81`/`G82`/`G83`/`G73`/`G84`/`G85`/`G86`/`G89`, RS-274 / ISO 6983) and keep the `#992` pre-drilled rule for `Thread`.
- Support an optional paired spot-drill operation when requested.
- Combine pattern creation and operation creation into one undo step with `BatchCommand` (`crates/app/src/commands/batch.rs`), and ship the matching MCP tool and Stock/Sketch UI form.

Clean-room rule: use plain machining terms only. Do not copy vendor wording, labels, or screen layouts.

**Safety floor:** produces hole coordinates and posted G-code (`effort:high`).

**Done means:** a point list, line, grid, and full or partial bolt-hole circle generate, verify against stock, post standard canned cycles (`G81`/`G83`/`G84`), round-trip `.camproj`, undo in one step, and pass MCP tests with no 3D model.

Part of #3045
